answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The horizon holds work receipts rather than names, so the nadir of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the anchor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
